entities.name: Doctor Nebun
entities.description: Vedalken Simic Combine viromancer and cytoplastician in Utvara who created potent viruses and later helped cure the kuga plague.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov advokist who confronted Nebun and obtained the curative serum.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Nebun's base of operations, struck by the kuga plague.

entities.name: Kuga plague
entities.description: Plague in Utvara cured with Nebun's serum.

entities.name: Cauldron
entities.description: Target of the attack by Teysa's strike force.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Creatures whose rampage wounded Utvara's citizens.

events.summary: Teysa Karlov confronts Nebun, and he gives her the curative serum for the kuga plague, enabling Utvara's purification.
events.quote: persuaded him to hand her the already developed curative serum for the kuga plague

events.summary: Nebun provides Teysa's strike force with virusoid golems for their attack on the Cauldron.
events.quote: he provided Teysa's strike force with his virusoid golems

events.summary: Nebun helps Utvara's citizens wounded during the nephilim's rampage.
events.quote: Nebun did his best to help the citizens of Utvara wounded during the rampage of the nephilim

relations.note: A member of the Simic Combine.
relations.quote: was a vedalken and a member of the Simic Combine on Ravnica

relations.note: Helped her against the plague and the Cauldron.
relations.quote: he provided Teysa's strike force with his virusoid golems
